description: Unify ideation storage behind the fluid-store provider seam (owner ruling 2026-07-21, PROVIDER-SEAM in what-to-build 8k): ideabox records become provider records on a zero-install local floor implemented over vision idea-type items; SmartMemory is the capability-rich reference provider backing the same records later. ideabox.md becomes a read-only generated view (ROADMAP.md<-feature.json pattern).
